description:
# CLASH OF COMMITS
### Build Your Clan. Prepare for War. Claim the Crown.

The kingdom is calling. The battlefield is open. Is your clan ready?

**Clash of Commits** is not your usual hackathon. It's a clan-based coding battlefield where ideas become weapons, code becomes your arsenal, and only the strongest clans make it to the crown.

Gather your squad of **4-5 members**, bring your boldest ideas, and prepare to battle through three rounds of innovation. Build your base, survive the raid, and fight your way into the Arena Finals!


**One battlefield. 120 clans. One crown.**

---

## ⚠️ BEFORE YOU ENTER THE BATTLEFIELD

**This registration is ONLY for Round 1 – Build Your Base (Online).**

Registering here does not guarantee participation in the offline rounds.

- Shortlisted clans must complete a separate registration through the institute portal to secure their participation in the offline rounds.
- Clans that fail to complete the institute portal registration will not be eligible to compete offline, even if shortlisted.
- **Joining the official [WhatsApp group](https://chat.whatsapp.com/GIVDrZr0hm8AenbuZxNJfp) is MANDATORY.** All announcements, shortlists, deadlines, problem statements, and schedule updates will be shared there first.
- Missing important announcements will not qualify clans for rescheduling or special exceptions.

**Battlefield Communication Channels**
- WhatsApp Group: [https://chat.whatsapp.com/GIVDrZr0hm8AenbuZxNJfp](https://chat.whatsapp.com/GIVDrZr0hm8AenbuZxNJfp)

---

## THE ROAD TO THE CROWN

Three rounds. Two Clan Wars. One ultimate champion.

### ROUND 1: BUILD YOUR BASE
*Online | Idea Submission*

Every legendary kingdom starts with a strong foundation. This is where your clan makes its first move.

Submit a **10-slide idea deck** showcasing:
- The problem you're setting out to solve.
- Who you're building for.
- Your proposed solution.
- Your technology stack.
- Your execution and build plan.

Every submission will be evaluated, and the **top 120 clans** will earn their place in the offline battlefield.

Build wisely. Your journey starts here.

### ROUND 2: THE RAID
*Offline | 24-Hour Hackathon*


The shortlisted clans enter campus for an intense **24-hour building showdown**. Turn your ideas into working solutions, tackle problem statements, collaborate with mentors, and make every second count.

But the battlefield has its own economy: **ELIXIR**.

Once the code freeze hits, it's time for **CLAN WAR I**.

Judges evaluate every submission based on innovation, technical depth, impact, and execution. Only the **top 8 clans** survive the raid and advance to the Arena Finals.

### ROUND 3: ARENA FINALS
*Offline | The Ultimate Pitch Battle*

Eight clans enter. Only one walks away with the crown.

Welcome to **CLAN WAR II**.

The top 8 clans face off in a knockout pitching bracket. Present your solution, demonstrate what you've built, and convince the judges why your clan deserves the throne.

With a live audience, high-stakes presentations, and an audience vote, every pitch matters.

The final showdown is the **CROWN MATCH** — where the last two contenders battle it out to determine the ultimate champion.

---
## CHOOSE YOUR BATTLEFIELD

Eight tracks. Countless possibilities. Your clan decides what to build.

**AI & MACHINE LEARNING**
Build intelligent agents, develop generative AI applications, explore computer vision, or push the boundaries of predictive models and edge AI.

**ROBOTICS & IoT**
Bring hardware to life with autonomous systems, drones, smart sensors, microcontrollers, embedded intelligence, and connected technologies.

**WEB & APPLICATIONS**
Create powerful full-stack platforms, mobile applications, SaaS products, developer tools, and scalable digital experiences.

**BLOCKCHAIN & WEB3**
Explore decentralised applications, smart contracts, DeFi, DAOs, digital assets, and next-generation decentralised infrastructure.

**AR, VR & EXTENDED REALITY**
Build immersive experiences through augmented reality, virtual reality, mixed reality, spatial computing, and interactive virtual environments.

**CYBERSECURITY**
Challenge vulnerabilities, strengthen digital security, develop threat detection systems, and explore ethical hacking, privacy, and digital forensics.

**FINTECH & BUSINESS INNOVATION**
Reimagine financial services through digital payments, financial intelligence, automation, algorithmic trading, and innovative business solutions.

**OPEN INNOVATION**
No boundaries. No restrictions. Explore HealthTech, ClimateTech, EdTech, Data Science, Smart Cities, or anything beyond the ordinary. Turn your boldest ideas into impactful real-world solutions.

## READY TO CLAIM THE CROWN?

Your clan has been formed. Your strategy is ready. Now it's time to enter the battlefield.

**YOUR NEXT MOVES:**

1. **Register Your Clan: Devfolio Registration
2. **Join the WhatsApp Group:** [https://chat.whatsapp.com/GIVDrZr0hm8AenbuZxNJfp](https://chat.whatsapp.com/GIVDrZr0hm8AenbuZxNJfp)
3. **Build Your Base:** Submit your 10-slide idea deck before deadline.
4. **Prepare for the Raid:** If shortlisted, complete your institute portal registration to secure your offline participation.

**BUILD YOUR BASE. SURVIVE THE RAID. CONQUER THE ARENA.**

*The battlefield awaits. The crown belongs to the strongest.*
